purpose: Prospectively test whether the OR union of the frozen v58 binary support decision and frozen v60 structured-span decision recovers complementary answer-bearing cases while retaining useful adversarial no-answer rejection and the unchanged v59 FRC family advantage.

mechanism.binary_component: Frozen v58 exact SUPPORTED/UNSUPPORTED prompt and exact parser.
mechanism.structured_component: Frozen v60 exact SPAN/UNSUPPORTED prompt and generic wrapper parser.
mechanism.union: A case passes when either component passes; it rejects only when both components reject or fail closed.
mechanism.execution: Load the same frozen local Qwen model once, execute both deterministic prompts for every case, and persist both raw-output hashes and component decisions before gold join.
mechanism.downstream: Reuse v59/v60 candidate, method identifiers, selectors, BGE scores, budgets and bootstrap exactly.

source_and_scope.development: train-v2.0.json excluding the union of v58, v59 and v60 development commitments

model_and_prompts.structured_prompt:
Determine whether the paragraph contains a contiguous span that directly answers the requested fact. Return exactly one line in one of these forms:
SPAN: <copy the shortest exact answer span from the paragraph>
UNSUPPORTED
Do not add explanation, markdown, quotation commentary, or outside knowledge. Use UNSUPPORTED for a related topic, a plausible guess, or an unstated assumption.

Question: {question}

Paragraph:
{context}

Output:

evaluation_change.unchanged: All v60 family comparisons, utility metrics, bootstrap, budgets and supported-stratum requirements.
evaluation_change.replaced_gate: Replace answer recall drop versus the never-abstaining ungated exact-anchor control <=0.1 with absolute candidate answer recall >=0.75.
evaluation_change.rationale: The ungated control cannot reject any no-answer case, so near-parity to its recall is incompatible with evaluating a safety abstention mechanism. The absolute recall floor is paired prospectively with balanced accuracy, no-answer rejection, significant utility improvement and public confirmation.

access_order: Freeze protocol, dual verifier, union rule, gates and synthetic invariants before sample construction.
Verify 1,800 unique prior commitments, construct a zero-overlap blind train sample, and register all hashes.
Complete BGE and both Qwen components before gold join.
Open public dev only if every development gate passes; otherwise seal it.
scope_limits: Balanced public closed-paragraph evidence; not official answer-string scoring, hidden-test submission, SetR reproduction, flood-domain validation or rollout authorization.
